trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production, so I did not use it.
- **Current state:** All regions are on v2.3.0 and report healthy. Error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry returned one incident, so no duplicate was created. It describes the failure, the rollback, and next steps: confirm recovery and investigate v2.3.1 before any redeploy.
